text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt a 3-pixel solid focus ring with a 3-pixel outer glow in the brand color for all interactive elements. This balances visibility for keyboard users with modern aesthetics—glow adds clarity without overwhelming small touch targets. Trade-off: glow slightly increases render cost on low-end devices, but the benefit to users outweighs the minor performance hit.

name: Reader
text: Risk: The 3px ring + 3px glow risks creating a "halo effect" that obscures adjacent content on small screens or when zoomed. Better alternative: Use a 4px solid ring with 20% opacity in the brand color—higher contrast, no glow, no blur. Settle with a live contrast test on a 320px viewport with 200% zoom.
